blocks.text:
## Explore Argentine agricultural technology in practice

We invite farm managers, agronomists and agribusiness specialists to [Argentina](/argentina/). This business tour focuses on practical professional questions: how to conserve moisture and soil fertility, choose crop rotations and sowing rates, work with heavy soils and monitor grain quality after harvest.

You will explore scientific approaches on farms, in trial plots and in meetings with consultants. Agricultural education is another focus, from early learning through professional workforce training.

## We arrange your delegation’s trip

We take care of accommodation, ground logistics, meals, coordination and specialist interpretation. Between technical visits, we offer a nature day in Sierra de la Ventana, a stop on the Atlantic coast in Mar del Plata and a chance to explore Buenos Aires with a tango show.

Send us your group size and professional interests. We will agree the objectives of your meetings, prepare a schedule and provide an individual quotation for your business tour.
